title: LTX-2.3-GGUF distribution and Dynamic 2.0 GGUF guidance linked
summary: On 2026-03-16, the record linked an Unsloth Hugging Face repository for LTX-2.3-GGUF together with Unsloth documentation for Dynamic 2.0 GGUFs. This is a material distribution-and-usage milestone because it connects an LTX 2.3 GGUF artifact with relevant guidance for practitioners. The dated links alone do not establish exact model capabilities, supported runtimes, or release status.
